en: Nyeeeh...
You're the same as ever, Himiko.

This is normal for me...
If you don't like it, talk to someone else...

It's not that I don't like it. It's just...I'm
worried about your well-being...

There's no need to worry. Actually, why are 
you paying so much attention to me anyway?

Hm? Mmm... I just worry about you for some
reason...

For some reason...?
Are you...playing for the other team?
The other team? What do you mean by that?

If you don't get it, that means 
you probably aren't...
Huh? Now, I wanna know.

Don't worry about it.
Explaining is a pain...

...I think I've heard you say the word "pain"
enough times to last me a lifetime.
So if you're not playing for that team...
I see... You thought I'd be an easy target.

Huh? Easy target?
I don't get that either.
Popular girls like you...

No, never mind...
If you don't get it...it's fine...

Again? Fine...if you don't wanna talk about
it, then you don't have to.

But anyway...why do you bother me so much?
Is it because you're the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Magician<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

I'm not a magician.
I'm the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Mage<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Oh, sorry! Yeah, that.

Sheesh...my magic has brought smiles 
to many children, y'know?

Oooohhh! I got it! I know why you bother
me so much, Himiko!
Huh? Are you...a mage, too?

No, not that... You talked about putting
smiles on people's faces, right?
I feel the same way.

Seeing smiles on everyone's faces after my
performances was so much fun.
Don't you feel the same way, Himiko?
Yes...

When I see children smiling because of 
my magic...it makes me happy. It's fun.

We're very similar in that sense, so I was
concerned about you.
We're alike.
We're not alike at all...

Our idea of happiness and enjoyment is the
same...like our talents fit that role.

Aside from our personality, I think we're
more similar than you think.

Is that so?
I don't really get it...

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko shook her head, but I could see the
truth on her face, clear as day.
<CLT=cltMIND>We're probably alike.

In the same way I wanna escape this place
so I can make people smile...

You wanna perform your tricks in front
of those kids, huh?

Uh, I mean...you wanna perform your *magic*
and make those kids smile, right?
Hm...

I can't let my magic...waste away here.
It'd disgrace my title of <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Mage<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Right? Then, let's work together to escape
from this place!

That sounds like a pain, so I'll leave 
that to you.

Whaaat!? Y-You're supposed to say,
"Let's work together!" too!

<CLT=cltMIND>Seriously... Himiko sure likes to go at her
own pace.

<CLT=cltMIND>But I feel like we became a lot closer...
We know more about each other now.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Himiko's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Himiko, I returned
to my room.
